message: 男の子が好きなモノ

name: Azel
message: 「When is the Holy Night Festival?」

name: Everyone
message: 「Ehhh!?」

name: Ria
message: 「You didn't know?」

name: Azel
message: 「I had no need to.」

name: Synn
message: 「So you're interested in it now.」

name: Azel
message: 「I still don't need to know.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's December 24th.」

name: Azel
message: 「I-I didn't ask you to tell me.」

name: Ria
message: 「The Holy Night Festival, huh......」

name: Misa
message: 「Big Sister. Is there something on your mind?」

name: Ria
message: 「According to Sis, it sounds like the next Re-Crea will happen right around the Holy Night Festival.」

name: Synn
message: 「No way! Is this year's Holy Night Festival in trouble!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Preventing that is the very reason we Crusaders exist, isn't it? Pull yourself together.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Any party pooper who tries to ruin a fun festival is gonna get beat to a pulp!」

name: Azel
message: 「......December 24th, huh.」

name: Misa
message: 「That's only two months away.」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't worry, we'll be fine. We can't let our guard down, but we still have time.」

name: Misa
message: 「I am not worried at all. Setting Sakura-kun aside, if we all combine our strength, we can accomplish anything.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You should just be honest and acknowledge Synn's strength too.」

name: Ria
message: 「Misa-chan already knows that, too.」

name: Misa
message: 「I-If you say so, Big Sister...... then I suppose I'll let it slide for now!」

name: Azel
message: 「......I hope things go well.」

name: Synn
message: 「It'll go just as smoothly as KiraFes, as long as we have everyone's help.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「However, Mr. President, for the time being, we also have to take care of the matters right in front of us.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, come to think of it, I heard some kind of complaint came in.」

name: Misa
message: 「Apparently, the new part-timer at Prier is being overbearing.」
